en: Colorized historic postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic church with a very tall spire and smaller side spires, surrounded by a landscaped park and low town buildings. The sky is a smooth gradient from light beige at the horizon to blue above. Printed German text at the top identifies the place as Hainichen and the church as the Trinity Church. Publisher and production notes are printed vertically along the left and right margins.
